title: Instantiating FAST's Sbox-Index Generator
summary: FAST specifies the role of its Sbox-index generator and prefers AES in CTR mode, but selecting or constructing a suitable instantiation remains open.

formal_statement.body: The FAST format-preserving encryption and tokenization construction requires a pseudorandom generator $\text{PRNG}_{1,m,n}$ that, given an $L_1$-bit key $K_{\text{SEQ}}$, outputs an $n$-element Sbox-index sequence $\text{SEQ}=[i_0,i_1,i_2,\ldots,i_{n-1}]$ whose entries lie in $\{0,1,\ldots,m-1\}$. The unresolved task is to determine or construct a suitable instantiation of this generator for these parameters; AES in CTR mode is identified as a preferred option, but the generator choice remains open.

scope.domain: This problem concerns pseudorandom Sbox-index sequence generation in FAST format-preserving encryption and tokenization.
parameters: L₁: bit length of the input key
KSEQ: key supplied to the generator
n: number of indices in the generated sequence
m: range parameter, with indices running from 0 through m−1
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine or construct a suitable instantiation of the generator for these parameters; AES in CTR mode is preferred, but the choice remains open.

citations.label: FAST: Secure and High Performance Format-Preserving Encryption and Tokenization

progress.summary: The paper explicitly presents the generator choice as open and identifies AES in CTR mode only as its preferred option.
citation_labels: F. Betül Durak et al., FAST: Secure and High Performance Format-Preserving Encryption and Tokenization
